test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 03
subject: general
question: According to the United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (ESCAP) report, what is the projected growth rate for India's economy in the year 2027?
solution: The correct answer is __**6.6%**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** • The **United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (ESCAP)** has released projected economic growth rates for India for the upcoming years. • These projections are part of the report titled **Economic and Social Survey of Asia and the Pacific 2026**.
